item.title: Israel frees suspects in two settler attacks as West Bank pogroms intensify
item.description: Israeli court releases nine settler suspects over West Bank attacks as investigations into recent assaults continue.

item.title: Trump says NBA star LeBron James disrespected US national anthem
item.description: NBA superstar LeBron James criticised by US President ⁠Donald ⁠Trump for disrespctful behaviour during national anthem.

item.title: Iran says seven ships hit in Hormuz Strait, warns US of wider response
item.description: The US has pushed back on the IRGC's claims, dismissing them as an attempt to increase oil prices ahead of US elections.

item.title: US-sanctioned ICC wins top EU human rights award
item.description: The EU has awarded the International Criminal Court its top human rights award.

item.title: ‘Longer we wait, worse it gets’: Struggle of Gaza’s breast cancer patients
item.description: Breast cancer patients in Gaza face delayed diagnoses, medicine shortages and limited access to scans and treatment.

item.title: Foreign national beaten to death by a mob in South Africa
item.description: Police say a 50-person mob in Durban killed a man amid a wave of anti-migrant marches.

item.title: Sri Lanka beat England to overcome Harry Brook hitting fastest 200 in ODIs
item.description: England captain Brook hits 202 in record ODI time, but Sri Lanka hit a six to win by two wickets with one ball to spare.

item.title: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli soldier abusing cat goes viral
item.description: A video of an Israeli soldier throwing a cat over a fence has gone viral online.

item.title: Albanian lawmakers scuffle in parliament as street protests continue
item.description: Albanian lawmakers have scuffled in parliament, throwing objects at one another and ripping microphones from desks.

item.title: FIFA announces USA to host first Women’s Club World Cup in 2028
item.description: FIFA to stage inaugural Women's Club World Cup, with 16 of football's top teams, in United States in 2028.

item.title: Two Syrian security officers killed in raid on ISIL cell near Damascus
item.description: The Syrian Interior Ministry says five suspected fighters killed and six arrested outside of Damascus.

item.title: South Africa crush Australia by an innings to level cricket Test series
item.description: South Africa storm back to crush Australia by an innings in the second Test and level the series 1-1 with one to play.

item.title: Israeli attacks kill four as famine risk looms in Gaza
item.description: Four Palestinians killed as Israeli military expands control across Gaza, displacing millions and destroying homes.

item.title: Italy and Spain lift border controls after months of tension over Ceuta
item.description: More than 70,000 people entered Ceuta irregularly from Morocco, triggering border security concerns in the EU bloc.

item.title: Real Madrid’s complaint over La Liga chief’s Nazi slant sent to tribunal
item.description: La Liga ⁠chief ⁠Javier Tebas compared Real Madrid's communication to Nazi propaganda and now faces a tribunal in Spain.

item.title: 16-year-old Malaysian student attacks his teacher with axe
item.description: A 16-year-old Malaysian student attacked his teacher and fellow school pupils with an axe.

item.title: From the streets to the ballot box: Serbia’s students hope for election win
item.description: Young Serbians have built a system that poses a threat to President Aleksandar Vucic’s grip on power.

item.title: Fatal Custody
item.description: Two mothers warned family courts their children were in danger. Fault Lines investigates why warnings were ignored.

item.title: Rising costs and tight budgets strain Americans ahead of midterm elections
item.description: Rising costs leave US workers juggling multiple jobs as financial security becomes increasingly elusive.

item.title: Carney, Erdogan launch ‘strong and resilient’ Canada-Turkiye partnership
item.description: On trade, investment and innovation, leaders will work towards conclusion of a Canada-Turkiye Free Trade Agreement.

item.title: Netanyahu promises Iran regime change: Can Israel topple Tehran government?
item.description: Israel can inflict devastating damage on Iran, but analysts question its ability to overthrow Tehran’s government.

item.title: Germany arrests Ukrainian man accused of spying for Russia
item.description: Military has raised the threat level of ​Russian sabotage against German troops and facilities.

item.title: Ilhan Omar home raid, Haines attack: Inside rise in violence on officials
item.description: US Congresswoman Ilhan Omar's home raided; Australian MP Helen Haines loses both legs following an attack.

item.title: FIFA’s Infantino made to wait on Asian support as chief coy at AFC session
item.description: 'We’re not against anyone and we’re not in favour of anyone,' says AFC President Sheikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa.

item.title: India resist New Zealand fightback to win record-setting T20 cricket opener
item.description: New Zealand reach their highest home total against India, 225-4, but Sanju Samson hits fifty to top the record in chase.
